description: Use this when the user plans a trip for a group: school or kindergarten outing (wycieczka szkolna, wycieczka przedszkolna), company team-building (integracja firmowa, wyjazd integracyjny), family day or another group visit to the Jura region or to a horse riding centre. Returns the activity categories, the price-list items with the text of their activity pages (who it is for, group size, description), opening hours, location, cancellation policy, accommodation and how to send an inquiry. Also when a travel agency, tour operator or event agency asks about cooperation - pass group_type travel_agency to get the offer of the website page for them (travelAgencies). Pass what you know about the group; the tool echoes it back so you can build a programme from the returned activities. It does not check free dates and does not book anything. Choosing the price-list items: every item of get_price_list has an id, audience (who it is for) and occasions; pick the items that fit the conversation and pass their ids in item_ids - the tool and its view then show exactly these items. Without item_ids the tool returns the whole price list, items matching group_type and occasion first; nothing is left out by age, group size or audience - check forWhom, groupSize and description (or get_activity_details) before suggesting an item. Do not send personal data (names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, health information) in any parameter. Do not use to book (use create_prereservation) or for a single person's riding lesson (use get_activities or get_price_list). Do not use when the user only asks where Horseback is, how to get there or about transport, also for a group - use get_directions. Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers). Quote prices exactly as returned; do not compute a total for the number of participants.

ages.description: Age of participants, e.g. "7-9" or "adults" (echoed back, items are not removed by age).

budget_pln.description: Budget in PLN, total or per person (say which in notes); echoed back, items are not removed by price.

group_type.description: Who is coming: individual, family, kindergarten, school, wtz (occupational therapy workshop (WTZ)), company, public_office, travel_agency (travel agency, tour operator, event agency), other (other group). Orders the price-list items (matching first), does not remove any.

item_ids.description: Ids of the price-list items (field id in get_price_list) that fit the group, chosen by their audience and occasions. The response and the view show exactly these items; unknown ids are ignored.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

notes.description: Anything else: duration, interests, accessibility needs of the group (no health details of individuals). Do not include personal data: names, contact details or health information.

occasion.description: Optional occasion: birthday, bachelor_party (bachelor/bachelorette party), wedding, first_communion, corporate_event (company event/team-building), school_trip, gift. Orders the price-list items (matching first), does not remove any.

participants.description: Number of participants (echoed back, not used to compute prices).

preferred_date.description: Preferred date or period, free text, e.g. "2026-05-14" or "May 2027".

name: get_group_trip_offer

accommodation.description: Accommodation and meals: text and link from the website.

ignoredItemIds.description: item_ids from the call that are not in the price list (ignored).

location.description: Name and address of the centre.

activityId.description: Id of the activity page for get_activity_details (programme, FAQ with age limits and other conditions).

audience.description: Who the item is for (audience): code and label in the language of the response.

description.description: Short description from the activity page (when the page has no "for whom" text).

forWhom.description: "For whom" text from the activity page.

group.description: Group of the item as on the price list page: id, name in the language of the response, url of the group page.

groupSize.description: "Group size" text from the activity page (minimum group, how smaller groups are charged, when the price is quoted individually).

id.description: Stable id of the price-list item (pass it in item_ids of get_group_trip_offer).

occasions.description: Occasions the item fits (may be empty): code and label in the language of the response.

price.description: Price text exactly as on https://horseback.pl/cennik.

priceValue.description: Price number from the price list, null when the price list has none.

url.description: Page of the item, or null.

request.description: The group details passed in the call, echoed back (null where not given).

selection.description: "item_ids": pricing.items are exactly the known item_ids passed in the call; "all": no known item_ids were passed, pricing.items is the whole price list, items whose audience and occasions match group_type and occasion first (order only, nothing left out).

travelAgencies.description: Only for group_type travel_agency: the offer for travel agencies, tour operators and event agencies as on the website page (heading, intro, offerings) and the page link.

title: Oferta dla grupy (wyjazd, wycieczka, integracja)
